answer: Based on Document 1, the pro-ration factor for subsidised treatments like Continuation of Autologous Bone Marrow Transplant for Multiple Myeloma applies to outpatient cancer treatments. However, Document 1 does not specify the exact pro-ration factor for permanent residents. [Document 1]
